# Create virtual tag folders without enabling their UI mode

WebExtension folder APIs need virtual tag folders even before the user selects Tags folder mode. SmartMailboxUtils creates these with smart mailbox setup, rather than relying on UI initialization.

Scope: smart mailbox folders.

Paths:

- `mail/modules/SmartMailboxUtils.sys.mjs`
